overview.description: The ProShares UltraShort Industrials (SIJ) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Industrials Select Sector index. The fund provides 2x inverse daily exposure to a market cap-weighted index of S&P 500 industrial stocks. SIJ was launched on Jan 30, 2007 and is issued by ProShares.
